commitMessageFormat.title: Commit message format ({id} and {summary} are replaced; local tasks have no ID)

fillCommitTemplate.title: Pre-fill the commit message from the active task
fillCommitTemplate.description: Write the active task's commit message to git's commit.template, which pre-fills the commit field (needs git; a template you set yourself is left alone)

branchNameFormat.title: Branch name format
branchNameFormat.description: Branch name format ({id} and {summary} are replaced; local tasks have no ID, so an empty name falls back to the first two words of the summary)

githubRepository.title: GitHub repository as owner/name (leave empty to use the github.com remote)

githubAssignedOnly.title: GitHub: only issues assigned to me

gitlabProject.title: GitLab project as group/name
gitlabProject.description: Leave empty to use the gitlab.com remote, or all your issues if there is none.

forgejoRepository.title: Codeberg repository as owner/name (leave empty to use the codeberg.org remote)

youtrackHost.title: YouTrack host
youtrackHost.description: Such as acme.youtrack.cloud or youtrack.example.com. The IDE asks you to approve a self-hosted host on first use.

youtrackCloseState.title: YouTrack state to set when closing a task

jiraHost.title: Jira Cloud host, such as acme.atlassian.net

jiraQuery.title: Jira JQL query
jiraQuery.default: assignee = currentUser() and resolution = Unresolved order by updated

searchClosedIssues.title: Include closed issues in Search Issues
searchClosedIssues.description: GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg and Lighthouse issues.

lighthouseHost.title: Lighthouse Cloud tenant host, such as acme.lighthouseapp.com

fogbugzHost.title: FogBugz exact tenant host, such as acme.fogbugz.com

fogbugzProfile.title: FogBugz credential file
fogbugzProfile.description: Full path to the file that holds your FogBugz token, readable only by you (chmod 600). See FogBugz Cloud in the Tasks README.

selfHostedProfiles.title: Redmine, MantisBT and generic trackers
selfHostedProfiles.description: One entry per tracker, used by Search Issues. Tokens stay in a separate file readable only by you; see Self-hosted Redmine and MantisBT in the Tasks README.
